title: Extract the repeated reorder-amnesty confirm-dialog preamble in the tracks reorder screens
why: The same ~10-line block (fetch overdueCount, bail if unmounted, show ReorderConfirmDialog.showIfNeeded, bail if declined/unmounted) is copy-pasted 3 times across 2 files. A future change to the amnesty-guard contract has to be found and edited in 3 places; missing one leaves that screen silently skipping the guard.
recommendation: Extract a shared helper (mixin or top-level function taking WidgetRef/BuildContext/CurriculumId) used by all three call sites.
acceptance_criteria: Single shared implementation; all three call sites delegate to it
